title: HtmlSmall
responsibility: Renders the native small element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlSmall.attributes
inputs.description: Native small attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlSmall.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native small element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlSmall
outputs.description: The actual native small element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
